verdict.rationale: The pack shows Resend publishes API reference pages, such as send-email and create-webhook, and an OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. Nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples. A static reference and a machine-readable spec are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive, runnable capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
